title: Tungsten carbide buttons and inserts for use in Down-the-hole (DTH) bits
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard (IS 11672) prescribes technical specifications, requirements, tolerances, and testing procedures for Tungsten carbide buttons and inserts for use in Down-the-hole (DTH) bits.

clause_2_normative_references.title: Specification for Tungsten Carbide for Mining Tools

clause_3_terminology: Tungsten carbide buttons and inserts for use in Down

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
